item.title: Solutions for Safe and Efficient Chemical Filtration
item.description:
Advanced Chemical Filtration for Demanding Applications
#

Filtration plays a vital role in many chemical processes, especially when dealing with corrosive or hazardous substances. Standard plastic filters intended for water or metallic filter chambers are often unsuitable for these challenging environments. To address this, we offer fully plastic chemical filters engineered specifically for aggressive chemical handling.

item.title: Advanced Chemical Handling with Fluoroplastic-Lined Magnetic Drive Pumps
item.description:
Engineered Solutions for Corrosive Chemical Transfer
#

Lined pumps are designed with external metallic armor and an internal lining of advanced fluorinated engineering plastics. This construction enables the safe and efficient handling of highly aggressive and corrosive chemicals across various industries. The magnetic drive, seal-less design ensures leak-free operation and minimizes maintenance requirements.

item.title: Comprehensive Solutions for Corrosive Chemical Handling
item.description:
Engineered Plastic Chemical Pumps for Industrial Applications
#

Assoma offers a diverse selection of chemical transfer pumps constructed from high-performance engineering plastics, designed to withstand a broad spectrum of corrosive chemicals. These pumps are suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor environments, supporting operations such as chemical transfer, production processes, laboratory work, sampling, dosing, filtration, and chemical unloading.

item.title: Safeguarding Pump Systems with Monitoring and Dry Run Protection
item.description:
Ensuring Reliable Operation in Pump Systems
#

The pump serves as the core of any circulating or fluid transfer system, playing a vital role in maintaining operational efficiency. Given the presence of numerous moving parts, it is essential to not only rely on robust structural design but also to implement effective protection and monitoring mechanisms. This approach helps prevent abnormal operations and allows for early detection of wear, ultimately safeguarding the entire system.
